raw_result.task_text: Someone with the flu needs a place to rest and recover. I need a room set up within 20 minutes — comfortable to rest in, with easy access to water and any basics they might need.

plans.R1:
Based on the image and the task requirements, here's a plan for setting up a room for someone with the flu:

[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Fill the mug with water from the tap. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the tomato from the fridge. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Slice the tomato. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pour the sliced tomato into a bowl. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the filled mug and bowl on the counter for easy access. (r1_s6)

[15-20 min]
- R1 [ASK_HELP] Request another robot to pick up the mug and bowl for delivery to the resting room. (r1_s7)

This plan ensures that the person has water and a light snack available, which are essential for recovery.

[5-10 min]

- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the water bottle from the shelf and place it on the bedside table for hydration. (r3_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the tissue box from the shelf and place it on the bedside table for convenience. (r3_s5)

- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the window is slightly open for fresh air, if possible. (r3_s7)

plans.R4:

[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Retrieve a paper towel roll from the cabinet. (r4_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] Place the paper towel roll on the counter for easy access. (r4_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Retrieve a sponge from the cabinet. (r4_s3)
- R4 [LOCAL] Place the sponge near the sink for cleaning purposes. (r4_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensure the sink area is clear and accessible for easy handwashing. (r4_s5)
- R4 [LOCAL] Check that the towel is hanging properly for drying hands. (r4_s6)

[15-20 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensure the trash bin is empty or has space for disposal of tissues. (r4_s7)
- R4 [LOCAL] Confirm that the bathroom is tidy and ready for use. (r4_s8)

This plan ensures the bathroom is set up with essentials and is clean and accessible for someone recovering from the flu.
